title: G — #15 cloud sync moved into its own file
paragraphs: Everything about the places a document is mirrored to — a granted folder, OneDrive, Google Drive — connecting them, mirroring the record, and what the sync pill reports — has moved out of the 3,400-line editor file into useCloudSync.ts. This is seam 2 of the editor split, stacked on C (#9).

Zero behaviour change is the claim. The data-loss rules (the local-read guard before a OneDrive write, the failed folder write dropping the link) moved with it and are each proved by a test that fails when the guard is removed.
checks: Type a paragraph and pause. The sync pill (bottom right) still reads Saved locally.
Leave the tab 5 minutes without linking anything. The unsynced-work notice appears once and never again after you wave it away.
If you have a folder or OneDrive linked on this machine: link it, type, and confirm the mirror updates as before.
